Answers every call (overflow, after-hours, weekends, holidays), books jobs directly into the calendar, handles no-shows, rebooks cancellations, triggers review requests, and logs every lead. By Month 2, the full system is owned by the client. Pricing: $1,297/month, no setup fee, no contract, month-to-month. First 3 Founding Partners lock in $1,297/month forever; after that, price moves to $1,497/month permanently. Guarantee: The Dead Money Guarantee — if the system doesn't recover enough incremental booked jobs to cover the first 3 months ($3,891) within 90 days, work continues at no charge. Included free: GEO-optimized website, Command Center Dashboard, Weekly Win Report, AI Search Visibility Experiment. Territory: 1 contractor per zip code, 5 per city maximum. Discovery call required.
